newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: S.Lanka rubber falls in line with overseas trend.
newsitem.headline: S.Lanka rubber falls in line with overseas trend.

text.p: Rubber prices fell sharply at the Colombo auction on Thursday in line with the trend in overseas market, traders said.
"Prices fell as the local market reacted to overseas declines which took place after the Thai bhat was floated on Wednesday," said Lanil waniganayake of exporter Alma trading Company.
Best latex one-x, the purest grade, fetched 80 rupees ($1.37) per kg, compared to 87 rupees last week, brokers said. Number one fell to 80 rupees from 84.50. RSS1 was unquoted again.
On offer was 250 tonnes, which was an average quantity, brokers said.
